rawLevel: Exercise a high degree of caution
summary: Indonesia is under an overall advisory of 'Exercise a high degree of caution' due to political and social tensions and the threat of terrorism throughout the country. Specific regions with higher warnings include all provinces of Indonesian Papua (except Raja Ampat Regency islands and Sorong city) due to violent incidents, threats from militant groups, and kidnapping risks. Terrorism remains a concern, with potential targets including tourist areas, public transportation, and crowded places.

rawLevel: Exercise a high degree of caution
summary: Thailand is under a general advisory of 'Exercise a high degree of caution' due to ongoing political tensions, sporadic demonstrations, and an ongoing threat of terrorism. Specific regions with higher warnings include the Thailand-Cambodia border (avoid all travel due to tensions and land mines) and the southern provinces of Narathiwat, Pattani, Yala, and southern Songkhla (avoid all travel due to violent attacks by separatist insurgents).

rawLevel: Exercise a high degree of caution
summary: Exercise a high degree of caution in Türkiye due to the threat of terrorist attacks and the possibility of demonstrations throughout the country. Avoid all travel to within 10 km of the borders with Iraq and Syria due to the unpredictable security situation and the threat of terrorism. Avoid non-essential travel to the southeastern provinces of Hakkari and Şirnak due to the unpredictable security situation.

rawLevel: Exercise a high degree of caution
summary: The Government of Canada advises exercising a high degree of caution for travel to Egypt overall due to ongoing tensions, an unpredictable security situation, and the threat of terrorism. Specific regions with higher warnings include Northern Sinai (avoid all travel due to terrorist activity and military operations), the Western Desert and Libyan border area (avoid all travel due to smuggling, terrorist activities, and armed groups), and the northern part of South Sinai (avoid non-essential travel due to terrorism).

The Government of Canada advises against all travel to Kuwait due to a volatile security situation in the region, including ongoing military activity and missile/drone attacks that have struck civilian infrastructure. There is also a persistent threat of terrorism targeting foreign military installations, places of worship, and public areas frequented by foreigners. The advisory highlights risks of petty and violent crime, particularly in the Jleeb Al-Shuyoukh area of Kuwait City, as well as cybercrime and unexploded ordnance hazards near the Iraq border.

The Government of Canada advises avoiding non-essential travel to Israel due to the volatile security situation in the region, including ongoing military activity and potential travel disruptions. Specific areas with higher warnings include Jerusalem (avoid non-essential travel), the Golan Heights bordering Syria (avoid all travel), the area within 5 km of the Lebanon border (avoid all travel), and the area within 10 km of the Gaza Strip border (avoid all travel). The West Bank also faces high tensions and frequent violent clashes.
